widgets_values:
## audio/albums/drive-through/secret-homage/album

Album **Secret Homage** by **Drive-through** (20 tracks).

Queue this graph to zip whatever is already in `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/albums/Drive-through/Secret Homage/`.
Generate the full album in one go:

`./scripts/manage.sh album-render --album drive-through/secret-homage --art skip|upload|generate`

Occupancy: audio for tracks, klein first when --art generate. Do not co-resident Klein + ACE-Step.
Prompt enhance is **off** so authored text (recipe, script labels, ACE tags, or film shots) is encoded as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.
